basis: Measured on a 16 GB Mac with Ollama 0.34.2: gemma4:12b-it-qat takes 40+ s per annotated frame (11 s image prefill + 30 s decode) against a 3 s budget, and does not fit next to qwen3.5:4b (3.4 GB) once ordinary apps are open. Writing Skills, qwen3.5:4b ran at 29.5 tok/s against Gemma 4 12B's 12.1 tok/s and wrote a Skill in 153 s against 230 s, of comparable quality, so 16 GB Macs run qwen3.5:4b for everything. 8 GB Macs annotate with qwen3.5:2b-q4_K_M (1.9 GB, ~55 tok/s, valid annotations 10/10 on the focus_dailynews prompts), resident all day in ~2.3 GB instead of ~3.8 GB, and write Skills with qwen3.5:4b (18 correct steps against 10 for qwen3.5:2b). From 24 GB a Gemma 4 QAT model writes Skills and synthesis. Where the two models differ the worker loads one at a time: annotation first, then Skills.
